abilities.effect: The rope squawks like an angry squirrel from the point where the barrier was breached. This alarm is as loud as a human scream and lasts for 1 minute. If an item or creature is still breaching the barrier at the end of this duration, the alarm immediately triggers again.
abilities.name: Alarm

traits.name: Primal
traits.text:
This magic comes from the primal tradition, connecting to the natural world and instinct. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to primal magic.

abilities.trigger: An object or creature of at least 1 Bulk crosses an invisible vertical barrier extending 30 feet above and below the rope

hazard.description: A hempen rope tied between trees emanates an invisible, cylindrical barrier that sounds an alarm when crossed.
hazard.disable: DC 18 Thievery (trained) to move the rope without setting off the alarm, or *dispel magic* (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to disable the rope’s magic
hazard.name: Cordon Alarm
hazard.reset: The alarm resets immediately. Multiple breaches can cause the alarm to sound in multiple places at the same time, though the alarm can still be triggered only once per round.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
